# Marcut

> Local-first DOCX redaction for legal documents. Produces Microsoft Word
> output with native track changes, plus a JSON audit report. Detection is
> hybrid: a deterministic rules engine for structured PII, and a local LLM
> for names and organisations. No document ever leaves the machine.

Marcut ships as a native macOS app (Swift and SwiftUI) that embeds a Python
runtime in-process via PythonKit and a BeeWare Python framework. The same
Python core is usable directly as a `marcut` command-line tool.

Start with docs/INDEX.md. It carries one line per document with a scope
sentence and heading anchors, so you can jump to the exact section you need
rather than reading everything.

## Orientation

- [Docs index](docs/INDEX.md): the projection over every document in this repo. Read first.
- [Technical architecture](docs/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md): how the rules engine, the LLM passes and the Swift app fit together.
- [Domain glossary](docs/CONTEXT.md): what entity, span, cluster, rationale, scrub and hardening mean here.
- [Agent guide](CLAUDE.md): module map, build and test commands, and the repo's hard rules.

## Using it

- [User guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.md): running a redaction and reading the output.
- [Developer guide](docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md): building from source, including the required framework setup.
- [Contributing](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): branch and commit conventions, and the test gate.

## Design and history

- [Backlog](docs/BACKLOG.md): what is shipped, what is technical debt, and which directions carry a design spike.
- [Changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md): dated record of every behavioural change.
- [Design spikes](docs/design/): analysis written before implementation. Several flag correctness or privacy risks that matter before building.
- [Metadata hardening](docs/METADATA_HARDENING.md): every scrubbing pass applied to a DOCX.
